notes.title: New "Casual" difficulty mode added
notes.notes:
We just added a new difficulty mode to address the fact that even "Easy" was not easy enough for many players. "Casual" mode is even easier, giving you an opportunity to get better before switching to a more challenging mode. A new score leaderboard with that difficulty group has also been added.
I hope you have fun!

notes.title: Major Update finally here!
notes.notes:
PingBall just got a major update:

-Now a total of 20 original Levels.
-Fans that disturb the trajectory of the balls.
-Steam Leaderboard for each difficulty, you can now compare your skill with the world.
-Choice of offline mode if you are shy and prefer to compete locally.
-New refreshed user interface.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434071/8a85eec03a9f5e7acb530f26cc2037fe7df8b8ae.png[/img]

notes.title: PingBall just got released!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that PingBall is now available!

We recently added several new levels with moving bricks and obstacles, a scoreboard where you can follow your progress, a round system that makes the game evolve after you complete a full cycle, a bonus system that tracks how many ball you hit in multiball mode, just to name a few.

A round is composed of 14 original levels with increasing challenges, shape and obstacles, then after you complete a round of 14 levels:

Round 1: targets break in one hit
Round 2: targets need to be hit twice and reduce 20% in size
Round 3: targets need to be hit twice and reduce 40% in size
Round 4: same as 1 and targets pulsate by half
Round 5: same as 2 and targets pulsate by half
Round 6: same as 3 and targets pulsate by half
Round 7: you'll never get there :) !

Did I mention that there is 3 level of difficulty as well that change the ball minimum and maximum speed?

It is a lot of fun to play with a good range of motion. Make sure you strap on your controller and stay clear of furniture!
